FULL TEXT:
REGULAR MAZDOOR RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2025
NOTICE
No.- 28/R&A Dated: 08th May, 2025
This is for information to all concerned that Written Test (OMR based MCQ type) under
the Regular Mazdoor Recruitment Examination, 2025 (Advertisement No. PHC/01/2025)
shall be held on 22.06.2025 (Sunday) in single shift at various examination centres situated in
PATNA.
Admit cards for eligible candidates shall be uploaded on the official website of the High
Court: https://patnahighcourt.gov.in, one week before the scheduled examination date.
Candidates may download their admit cards from the designated link, to be made available on
the Court’s website. The eligible candidates shall also be intimated through SMS and e-mail on
their registered mobile number and e-mail ID in this regard. Admit card would not be sent to the
candidates separately through any other mode.
Examination centre allotted to the candidates will be final and no communication with
regard to change of examination centre shall be entertained.
No TA/DA will be paid for appearing at the examination.
The candidates are directed to strictly follow the instructions mentioned in the Admit
Card. They are also directed to affix their passport size photograph at the space provided in the
admit card. Candidates are also required to bring their valid identity proof in original with
its photocopy at the examination centre.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website regularly for further
details / updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/-
Registrar General
